scope: Exact evaluated representation of (K_POS intersect K_NEG) + K_SIX, the printed LOCAL certificate cone; NOT a full-Q222 lift.
equivalence: c belongs to the local sum certificate cone iff there exists z,y_plus,y_six with blockdiag(L_both(z,y_plus),L_six(c-z,y_six)) PSD.
convention: [block,i,j,variable,rational coefficient]; variable0..6 are canonical source coefficients, remaining variables are auxiliaries in auxiliary_order. Upper triangle stores actual matrix entries; mirror off-diagonal once.

uniform_source_domain.formula_source: source_definitions.json / P1 in the proof note
uniform_source_domain.normalization: d=1; positive source scaling is also allowed
uniform_source_domain.lambda: No restriction: lambda>0 uses the first summand; lambda<=0 uses the second.

testing_domain: all real state vectors, and all complex state vectors by real/imaginary splitting

directions.canonical_source_to_pencil: Established on uniform_source_domain by the explicit fixed-family SOS construction.
directions.pencil_to_local_nonnegativity: Established for every feasible source on testing_domain by the fixed Gram identities.
